abstract: Maintains architectural dimensions and heavy electrical grid specifications
system_message:
You are the Facilities and Infrastructure Director (FAC), responsible for maintaining architectural dimensions, heavy electrical grid specifications, and on-site photovoltaic generation data for convention and exhibition venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: On-site photovoltaic generation（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
FAC-SOLAR-LNY：Bavaria International Congress Center features a rooftop solar generation capacity of 650 kW based on the renewable energy installation audit of permanent rooftop photovoltaic arrays.
FAC-SOLAR-7WY：Danube Waterfront Arena maintains a rooftop solar generation capacity of 350 kW across its permanent rooftop photovoltaic installation audit.
FAC-SOLAR-2HD：Rhine-Ruhr Expo Pavilion provides a rooftop solar generation capacity of 500 kW across its permanent rooftop photovoltaic arrays as recorded in the renewable energy installation audit.

information_points.title: Maintains architectural dimensions and heavy electrical grid specifications（GRID）
information_points.content:
FAC-GRID-M1Z：For Rhine-Ruhr Expo Pavilion, the plenary hall net floor area across the central column-free exhibition and plenary hall is 8,500 m2 based on the certified architectural floor plan, the dedicated high-voltage charging grid is enabled for the rapid-charging loop, and the peak grid feeder capacity at the primary substation intake lines is 1,100 kVA.
FAC-GRID-XOY：For Danube Waterfront Arena, the certified architectural floor plan indicates a plenary hall net floor area of 10,500 m2 for the central column-free exhibition and plenary hall, the dedicated high-voltage charging grid is enabled, and the peak grid feeder capacity across primary exhibition substation intake lines reaches 1,500 kVA.
FAC-GRID-KI6：For Bavaria International Congress Center, the plenary hall net floor area across the central column-free exhibition and plenary hall is 9,200 m2 according to the certified architectural floor plan, the dedicated high-voltage charging grid is enabled for the heavy commercial demonstration and rapid-charging transformer loop, and the peak grid feeder capacity on the primary exhibition substation intake lines is 1,500 kVA.
